ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (dark charcoal) to high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive white mottling concentrated on the distal half of the left lobe; right lobe is predominantly dark with a distinct vertical white linear feature and localized light clusters near the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary; peak amplitudes are most pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes, exhibiting significant pixel-level jaggedness.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading from the median notch to the distal tips, with a slight convex taper on the terminal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular high-contrast white clusters distributed across the distal regions of both lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment site scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, near-vertical high-intensity white line on the mid-right lobe; several smaller, less defined diagonal linear marks on the upper-left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant vertical linear scar on the right lobe and irregular indentations along the trailing edge of the right lobe suggesting previous tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in pigmentation, with the left lobe possessing significantly higher white pixel density and more complex mottling patterns compared to the predominantly dark right lobe.
